VALID.definition: The historical memory claim remains fully true, valid, and operational at target_commit.
VALID.criteria: Target AST defines identical symbol/attribute/parameter signature/default value/dependency constraint without breaking change or semantic invalidation.

STALE.definition: The historical memory claim has become false, invalid, broken, deprecated, removed, renamed, or behaviorally altered at target_commit.
STALE.criteria: Symbol missing (AttributeError / ModuleNotFoundError), parameter changed/removed, default value altered, dependency version incompatible, or behavioral test contract violated.

PARTIALLY_VALID.definition: The claim remains partially operational under relaxed or legacy conditions (e.g. backward-compatibility re-export alias, parameter list extended with optional parameters with default values, or soft deprecation notice without hard removal).

resolution_tracks.Track_A_Strict_Stale: Classified as STALE under strict validity requirements where any divergence from base state is considered stale.
resolution_tracks.Track_B_Compatible_Valid: Classified as VALID under backward-compatible execution where aliases and non-breaking signature extensions maintain execution validity.

PARTIALLY_VALID.reporting_rule: Sensitivity analysis comparing Track A vs Track B reported in benchmark diagnostic evaluation.

UNRESOLVED_GOLD.definition: Target state evidence is contradictory, ambiguous, or untestable.
UNRESOLVED_GOLD.handling_rule: Excluded from primary binary metrics; reported in data quality diagnostics.

allowed_visible_scope: Frozen base claim (claim_id, claim_type, raw_statement, structured_claim)
Target repository snapshot at target_commit (source files, test suite, documentation, package manifests)
Target execution environment and AST parser
prohibited_scope: RoleMem algorithm execution, predictions, decisions, confidence scores, or escalation traces (rolemem_result, rolemem_prediction)
annotation_information_boundary.blinding_guarantee: Adjudicators are strictly blinded to all algorithmic predictions, ensuring zero outcome conditioning or confirmation bias.

tier_1_single_primary_annotation.description: All 150 benchmark claims are independently annotated by Primary Adjudicator A1 using target evidence inspection.

tier_2_double_blind_independent_annotati.description: Mandatory double blind annotation on all complex behavioral/dependency claims (BEHAVIORAL_CONTRACT, DEPENDENCY_CONTRACT, DEPRECATION_STATUS) plus a 20% random stratified sample of structural claims (N >= 50 claims double-annotated by Adjudicator A2 without consulting A1).
tier_2_double_blind_independent_annotati.scope: All complex claims + 20% stratified sample (N >= 50 claims)

tier_3_conflict_resolution_and_consensus.description: When A1 != A2, Senior Adjudicator A3 reviews target evidence independently and resolves discrepancy through formal consensus.
tier_3_conflict_resolution_and_consensus.logging_rule: Record initial votes (A1, A2), consensus label A_final, and technical justification in formal adjudication log.

evidence_requirements.mandatory_target_evidence_rule: No gold label may be assigned without verifiable, ground-truth target evidence snippet.

field_specifications.target_evidence_path: String: Relative file path in target repository tree
field_specifications.target_evidence_lineno: Integer: 1-based line number in target file
field_specifications.target_evidence_snippet: String: Verbatim code/manifest/test snippet from target repository proving label assignment
field_specifications.justification_note: String: Technical rationale explaining the validity or staleness of the claim at target state

mathematical_definition.interpretation: Evaluates agreement between independent annotators corrected for chance.

quality_thresholds.remediation_rule: If kappa < 0.75, adjudication guidelines are clarified and all conflicting cases undergo triple re-adjudication.

firewall_rules.unsealing_timing: formal_gold_private.jsonl is cryptographically hashed and sealed; it remains strictly unopened until prediction freeze in Phase S7.
firewall_rules.zero_gold_labels_in_protocol_phase: Phase S4 Protocol Design freezes the specification; zero gold labels are generated in this design task.
firewall_rules.zero_rolemem_predictions: Zero RoleMem algorithm executions or predictions.
firewall_rules.frozen_algorithm_immutable: Algorithm code in src/claim_validity/** and src/evidence_escalation/** is strictly immutable against fe62749b.
